title: Village Public Paving Kit
description: S03 public paving family with two selectable unit-scale nodes: Paving_Core_2x2 (2 x 2 m) and Paving_Entry_0p5x2 (0.5 x 2 m). Each has a local bottom-centre origin; default separated translations are a selection layout, not one installed tile. See the opening documentation in generate.py for dimensions, node selection and the validated installation table. Real shallow stone-joint relief and a soil-road-profile entrance. One kit, without navigation, accessibility or engineering guarantees.
